behavior: For an opted-in standard cold Git upload-pack POST with a valid local view, the existing gateway invocation authenticates a stateless Native plan, performs one authoritative DO manifest read and the first exact GET batch, then authenticates an owned bounded continuation. Native validates and consumes that prefix once, with any suffix fetched by ordinary code. Original discovery, warm, receive, unsupported and old-capability paths remain ordinary.

limits.new_metadata_ownership: All owning Option<AuthorityFingerprint> bytes and new fixed key Mutex/Atomic metadata charged to existing joint32MiB budget; no new object cache or retained R2 data.

authentication_and_authority: Distinct optional exact registration capability and32B HMAC key paired atomically with a valid same-session generation witness; absent legacy capability is allowed, malformed/unsolicited/duplicate capabilities fail registration and reset all local capabilities before further I/O.

Full frame HMAC covers original semantic request including exact body, all metadata, ordered manifest representation and garbage, exact full/prefix selection, ordered first batch and every payload byte; SHA256 verifies owned payload chunks before materialization. The proposed content-address-only authentication refinement was not used.

Authoritative manifest read and actual generation/full fingerprint match precede GETs. Native re-derives the complete plan after sequential handler release and never retains a pending session map, blob stash or lock across callbacks.

Published/local fingerprint pair is saved only after strict winning publication before local successful-retirement cleanup, invalidated before unknown transitions, refreshed by existing actual recover, and checked with generation/local digest plus existing lineage identity. This preserves full durable garbage authentication after real compaction.

Worker accepts each actual DO receipt once. Native continuation carries no service receipt to echo. Missing/unknown/truncated/corrupt/ambiguous outcomes remain charged or unknown and never trigger hidden retry; valid paid-but-unused prefetch falls back with costs retained.
